alt: A 9-second vertical video with our own music and no voice. A polished online-course card, cream to peach, with a generic instructor avatar, reads “5 Things Successful People Do Before 6 AM”, five gold stars, a price of $997 and a pink Enroll Now button. At 1.2 seconds Cella, a small dark doorway-shaped figure with two white eyes and a flat red crown, slides in from the right and the card spins out of frame. On a lime green field with pop stars, her own list appears: a sticker reads “Things I do before 6 AM”, huge pink word-art reads “1. Sleep.”, then “Beautifully.”, and a sticker says © CELLA. Cella closes her eyes, proud, breathing slowly.
comentario_fijado: Her list is shorter. What’s on yours before 6 AM? One word.
experimento_prueba: tarjeta pulida de gurú en el cuadro 0 que Cella tumba a los 1,2 s, contra el control pareado sin tarjeta (misma lámina, música y hora UTC); vistas, 'se quedó a ver' y visto medio en YouTube a 72 h
